facts.reusable: Procedural floor/wall/furniture construction, metre-scale primitives, chair-local colliders with world transforms.
facts.currentBoundary: Room, visual primitives and four obstacle entries are module constants. The scene has no facility catalog or layout loader.

facts.reusable: 0.2m eight-neighbour grid, heuristic-only greedy best-first search, exact interior segment tests, line-of-sight simplification and existing turn/motion controller.
facts.currentBoundary: No gScore, fixed bounds x+-4.05/z+-3.05, target clamping to x+-4/z+-3. One named chair has local-box special handling. Clearance is partly authored into obstacle extents. Actor-to-actor avoidance is outside this planner.

facts.reusable: Finite transform check, occupied/reserved/transitioning-chair guard, collider refresh and primary route recomputation.
facts.currentBoundary: No placement boundary/overlap/door connectivity/use-point preflight or transaction rollback. Only the primary controller route is recomputed.

facts.reusable: Arbitrary seatId/ownerId/requestId, duplicate/conflict handling, reserved/occupied/exiting/released, owner removal and release after physical exit. One active lease per owner.
facts.currentBoundary: The pure module can represent multiple distinct IDs. Its controller caller supplies only room-chair-1.

facts.reusable: Simulation-time deadlines, FIFO queue, stable request identity, one terminal result, cancellation/error cleanup and motion-driven completion.
facts.currentBoundary: Runtime dispatch supports walk/idle/sit/stand/turn/dance/greeting. There is no facilityInstanceId/usePointId target resolver or standing-use facility lifecycle.

facts.reusable: Chair-local approach/anchor/exit, heading alignment, calibrated pelvis contact and garment collision input.
facts.currentBoundary: One global chair, global chairBounds and fixed local exit test. Motion captures seatHeight on creation, currently profile0.47m, with read-only height/approach getters. Startup adjusts chair height and chair.z=1.05-seatBack. No setChairPose symbol or live per-facility height API exists.

facts.reusable: Independently parsed peer avatar/mixer/controller/task state advanced on the same Phaser simulation step and cleaned on removal.
facts.currentBoundary: Both controllers share the single global chair target. This is a two-instance isolation fixture.

facts.reusable: Existing appearance prepare/commit and identity checks, local appearance draft loading, exact-source package manifest/staging/export checks.
facts.currentBoundary: Appearance records contain no room/facility layout. The exporter is fixed to runtime801 and two selected looks. New layout resources require a new declared adapter and dependency closure.

firstPackageProposal.status: Reviewer proposal for chief integration, sample counts are suggestions
firstPackageProposal.name: Existing-room layout and facility source data contract
firstPackageProposal.gap: Visual layout, obstacle geometry, facility identity and use points currently live in unrelated hard-coded places.
inputs: Pinned room/controller/motion/lease source hashes in this report
Current desk/couch/plant/chair procedural dimensions and collider definitions
Existing original male/female body identities and current seat calibration
outputs: Versioned layout JSON and facility-resource JSON separating type/style, resource identity and instanceId
One faithful baseline source fixture and one chair-transform-only variant as a proposed minimum data contrast
Pure structural validator with path-addressed errors and unchanged-input behaviour
Recorded navigation/contact/transaction integration seams, including startup body-dependent chair calibration

layout: floor bounds, wall/opening descriptors and region connectivity
facilityResource: typeId/styleId and procedural recipe ID plus source/generator hash
local visual bounds, navigation footprint and clearance convention
usePoint ID, local approach/anchor/exit/heading, action semantic and occupancy policy

minimumAcceptance: Baseline fixture matches current source constants and separately records the runtime startup calibration instead of silently baking a body-dependent location
CPU validation handles finite transforms, IDs, resource-version references, local/world coordinate contract and structured failure without modifying input
A documented integration seam identifies later runtime navigation, rollback, interaction and persistence checks
firstPackageProposal.attemptBudgetProposal: One source/contract package plus at most one evidence-driven correction. Repeated same-root failure without new evidence triggers relocation of the seam.
firstPackageProposal.exitAndContinuation: Chief reviews the source contract, then uses an isolated integration window for the shared room loader/navigation adapter. Standing-use and multi-use-point fixtures, facility-state derivation, save/reopen and independent export each retain their runtime evidence step.

integrationDependencies.reason: Room construction, chair, navigation, peer and controller code are co-located. Integrate after the active M2 change is frozen, from an exact checkout.

Feed layout bounds/obstacles into the existing path and segment tests, preserve default-route and rotated-chair behaviour, define clearance. Validate use-point reachability on the candidate layout before committing it.

Stage models/colliders/nav/use points together, validate boundary/overlap/door connectivity and all affected actor paths, then commit once. Busy move/delete rejects and failures retain the prior layout. Track layout revision across asynchronous loading.

Map stable facility instance/use-point IDs into lease seatId and existing task identity. Replace global chair target reads at reserve/align/physical exit, with actual instance context. Independent multi-use slots need their own evidence.

The layout must own facility transforms. Current startup moves the chair from body metrics, and motion height is captured at construction. Preserve the tested0.47m sample first, then define the required per-use pose/contact seam before declaring other heights usable.
Pass the relevant facility contact colliders to garment/contact updates. Replan every affected actor. Cancelled use and owner removal must preserve physical-exit and lease-release ordering.

Version layout/resource dependencies and rebuild occupancy from valid actor/task context on load. Extend the fixed-candidate dependency inventory for the new company package and verify reopen/independent loading on that exact build.

checks: admission separated from execution; stable IDs and immutable snapshots
terminal exactly once, including reentrant listeners and callback errors
only simulation seconds advance timeout; queue wait included
dispose cancels every admitted pending/running task once
seat unique ownership, owner cannot collect stale second leases
sit task completes while chair stays occupied; cancellation/failure needs exit
destroyed owner releases reserved or occupied seat, never another owner
validation.scope: Actual existing pure behavior/lease module QA. No room-controller or physical seat use was run.

limitations: No implementation or company asset production
Current CAP SPACE-01/04 retain their existing measured static-room/single-chair/two-instance scope
Future gameplay/economy, full editor and server behaviour have no implementation evidence from this review
